newsitem.title: EGYPT: Five men killed in Egyptian vendetta.
newsitem.headline: Five men killed in Egyptian vendetta.

text.p: Unidentified men shot dead five brothers and cousins in southern Egypt on Monday, apparently to avenge the death of relatives slain a year ago, security sources said.
All those killed were from the Mausa family, which has a blood feud with the Gamoula family, they said.
The five men were driving along a road near the town of Qusiya, 300-km (180-miles) south of Cairo, when the gunmen sprayed them with bullets, they added.
